2608.07439.title: An Exploratory Evaluation of LLM-Assisted Rewriting of Moderate-Complexity Financial Sentences for DisCoCat-Based Sentiment Analysis
2608.07439.paper_summary: Quantum natural language processing (QNLP) provides a grammar-aware framework for text modeling, and Distributional Compositional Categorical (DisCoCat) is one of its theoretically grounded formulations. Prior work on financial sentiment analysis has identified practical limitations of DisCoCat, including parser sensitivity, high simulation cost, and difficulty handling longer sentences. We study an LLM-assisted preprocessing workflow that uses controlled rewriting to compress, simplify, or decompose moderate-complexity financial sentiment sentences into parser-compatible, circuit-efficient variants while preserving sentiment-bearing meaning. We compare prompting strategies, language models, and filtering configurations with the low-complexity-only DisCoCat baseline of Stein et al. At the circuit level, the strongest compression variants reduce average qubit and gate counts by more than 70 percent relative to the raw moderate-complexity subset. Across repeated training runs, GPT-4.1-mini with Prompt B achieves the highest observed mean accuracy, $0.550 \pm 0.035$, compared with $0.521 \pm 0.050$ for the baseline. Larger training splits do not necessarily improve downstream performance; across evaluated configurations, training-split size has a moderately negative association with accuracy (Pearson $r=-0.446$). These results provide exploratory evidence that LLM-assisted rewriting can make some moderate-complexity inputs usable within the evaluated DisCoCat configuration, while highlighting prompt design, filtering, and circuit-aware preprocessing as considerations for more scalable QNLP-based financial sentiment analysis.
2608.07439.paper_summary_zh: 量子自然語言處理（QNLP）提供了一個語法感知的文本建模框架，而分佈式組合類別（DisCoCat）是其理論基礎的表述之一。先前對金融情感分析的研究已經識別出DisCoCat的實際限制，包括解析器敏感性、高模擬成本以及處理較長句子的困難。我們研究了一個LLM輔助的預處理工作流程，該流程使用受控重寫將中等複雜度的金融情感句子壓縮、簡化或分解為與解析器兼容的電路高效變體，同時保留情感承載的意義。我們比較了提示策略、語言模型和過濾配置，與Stein等人的低複雜度DisCoCat基準進行比較。在電路層面上，最強的壓縮變體將平均量子比特和閘數減少了70％以上，相對於原始的中等複雜度子集。在重複的訓練運行中，使用提示B的GPT-4.1-mini達到了觀察到的最高平均準確率，$0.550 \pm 0.035$，而基準為$0.521 \pm 0.050$。較大的訓練分割不一定能改善下游性能；在評估的配置中，訓練分割大小與準確率之間有中度負相關（Pearson $r=-0.446$）。這些結果提供了探索性證據，表明LLM輔助的重寫可以使某些中等複雜度的輸入在評估的DisCoCat配置中可用，同時強調提示設計、過濾和電路感知預處理作為更具可擴展性的QNLP基礎金融情感分析的考量。
